exposure: ALK+ NSCLC with CNS metastases in pregnant woman
cohort: A 33-year-old pregnant woman with metastatic ALK+ NSCLC treated with lorlatinib and her baby.
finding: Successful maternal tumor control and normal fetal growth were observed with low-dose lorlatinib during pregnancy, and no congenital abnormalities were found in the baby at 20-month follow-up, though placental transfer of lorlatinib was confirmed.
